No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, seals, signatures, watermarks, or invented legal documents. Keep the main subject clear and visually dominant, with natural lighting and realistic proportions. The scene must communicate the specific issue without adding facts not present in the source.

visual_description: A modern open‑plan office bathed in soft, cool fluorescent light. In the foreground, a focused IT security analyst sits at a sleek black desk, hands hovering just above the keyboard, deliberately refraining from typing. The laptop in front of them displays a vivid red warning banner about an unauthorized intrusion, with a frozen‑in‑time screenshot of a login log (the log rows are visible as abstract lines and numbers, but no legible text). To the analyst’s right, a second colleague stands, holding a printed sheet of paper that shows a dense table of timestamps and event details (the rows are clearly visible as a grid, but the numbers are blurred to avoid legibility). The colleague’s other hand points to a small, sealed evidence bag placed on the desk, inside which a silver external hard drive rests on a white foam insert. A bright yellow sticky note with a bold red exclamation‑mark icon is affixed to the laptop screen, indicating “do not delete”. In the background, a glass‑walled server rack glows faintly, and a whiteboard on the wall holds a hand‑drawn diagram of a network map (only shapes and lines, no text). The camera angle is an over‑the‑shoulder shot from slightly above, capturing the analyst’s face, the laptop screen, the colleague’s gesture, and the evidence bag in a single cohesive frame. The lighting emphasizes the laptop’s glow and the reflective surface of the hard drive, while the overall tone remains calm yet urgent. MANDATORY VISUAL REGENERATION NOTES: A modern, professional IT security incident response office. A sleek black desk featuring a laptop showing a bright red unauthorized intrusion warning banner with abstract, blurred log lines. On the desk, a silver external hard drive is inside a clear sealed evidence bag. Next to it, a printed document with a blurred grid of timestamps. A yellow sticky note on the laptop monitor reads 'Do not delete' (ensure text is blurred or abstract to avoid illegible lettering issues). In the background, a glass-walled server rack with faint glowing lights and a whiteboard displaying a complex, abstract network diagram with lines and shapes. Cool, soft office lighting, clean professional composition, 4:5 aspect ratio. No people, no hands. No legible text on screen or paper. Avoid people and hands when possible. Prefer a clean, realistic scene with objects/documents only.
